announcements.title: Sky Music 4.1.0 — A Big Update
announcements.body:
We're pleased to announce Sky Music 4.1.0 — our biggest update yet.

What's new:
•  System-tray icon with a right-click quick menu
•  Keeps running in the tray when you close the window
•  Floating mini player, always on top
•  Global keyboard shortcuts (play, next, speed)
•  Equalizer presets — Bass Boost, Vocal, Treble, Flat
•  Sleep timer
•  Shuffle, repeat, and smart auto-advance
•  A-B loop to repeat part of a track
•  On-screen lyrics
•  Resume your last session
•  Custom cover image for your Discord status

The update installs automatically — just open Sky Music and select Yes when prompted.

Thank you for being part of Sky Music.

announcements.title: Sky Music 4.0 Is Here
announcements.body:
We're pleased to announce a major update to Sky Music.

What's new:
•  SoundCloud support, alongside YouTube
•  Voice effects — Baby, Chipmunk, Deep, Demon, Robot, Echo
•  Playlists
•  DJ-style speed control
•  Discord Rich Presence (now playing)
•  Customizable app theme

The update installs automatically — just open Sky Music and select Yes when prompted.

Thank you for being part of Sky Music.

announcements.title: Welcome to Sky Music
announcements.body: Play any track from YouTube or SoundCloud with studio-quality reverb.\n\nWe're glad to have you on board.
